title: She Got High Before Dropping Her Kid Off at School: Cops
description:
A mom in Connecticut got cuffed outside her child’s school after police allegedly found her behind the wheel with illegal narcotics. She told investigators she had just dropped her daughter off before cops rolled in asking her to perform field sobriety tests. Christina Morrisette was booked for driving under the influence and risk of injury to a child. Her case is still pending.

From high-speed chases to DUI arrests, Law&Crime BodyCam delivers the most shocking police encounters straight from the source. Subscribe now and catch the action:  @lawandcrimebodycam
